checks.label: Opening the desk never opens a microphone
Assisted destination selection prepares the exact addressed call
Selecting a task does not execute it
Written request reaches production parser and waits for readback
Say again repeats a readback without sending the order
Correct executes the requested carrier order once
Mission ledger displays the actual task outcome without serializing live world objects
Traffic shows the request, readback and confirmation
PTT rebinding remains available without capturing audio
Typed radio input owns its keys and never activates bound PTT
Invalid manual procedure is rejected by the same parser
Disregard withdraws an unconfirmed request without executing it
390px layout keeps radio controls inside the viewport
Escape closes the panel and cancels unfinished input
Legacy fleet board opens through a single explicit handoff
No browser errors
